methods.ci: Two-sided Student-t interval over valid observations, df=n-1 (n=24 gives t=2.069). Null is excluded; paired differences require both values. Every aggregate reports valid n; n<2 has no interval. Descriptive multiple-regime analysis, no multiplicity correction.
methods.acceptanceFrozen: Source-aware evidence must beat naive net work with positive paired 95% lower bound and lower mean Brier in at least two regimes, with no >10% mean work loss to private sensing in any regime. False-consensus rates are conditional on reported check counts, never evidence of truth by themselves.
